transcriptLines: Hello, how are you today?
I am fine, thank you for asking.
I have been studying English for two years.
I want to improve my speaking skills.
Yesterday I went to the library to find a good book.
The book was about the history of modern art.
I think that learning a new language is very difficult.
But if you practice every day, you will make progress.
My teacher said that I need to work on my pronunciation.
She also told me to listen to more English podcasts.
I am planning to travel to London next summer.
I hope I can speak English well by then.
Do you have any recommendations for good podcasts?
I usually listen to news podcasts in the morning.
Sometimes I watch movies with English subtitles.
This helps me understand different accents better.
My favorite actor is British, so I like his accent.
He speaks very clearly and uses interesting vocabulary.
I would like to visit the British Museum someday.
I have never been to the United Kingdom before.
